consequence.statement: Applications configured to sync on the in-cluster cluster will enter Unknown state without the possibility to sync resources; new Applications cannot be created using the in-cluster cluster; and deleting Applications will not delete the previously managed resources.
consequence.remediation: Perform cleanup or migration of existing in-cluster Applications before upgrading when in-cluster is disabled. To perform post-migration cleanup, the in-cluster will need to be enabled temporarily.

original.statement: When cluster.inClusterEnabled is set to "false", Applications currently configured to sync on the in-cluster cluster will enter Unknown state and cannot sync; new Applications cannot use the in-cluster cluster; and deleting Applications will not delete their previously managed resources.

decision.reason: [ev-adf2ed32df1c] says that when `cluster.inClusterEnabled: "false"` is set, Applications that target the in-cluster cluster go into an Unknown state and cannot sync resources. It also says new in-cluster Applications cannot be created, and deleting an Application leaves its managed resources behind. Those Applications stop working, so workload-failure (mandatory work) fits. The cleanup or migration is only "recommended", so migration-required would claim more than the evidence says. The statement and remediation match the evidence closely, and severity high fits Applications that can no longer sync.
